description: Inline implementations of ByteReader class methods for reading binary data, including byte reading, endianness handling, and LEB128 decoding, used in DWARF debugging information processing.

classes.name: ByteReader
classes.description: A class providing methods to read various data types from a byte buffer, considering endianness, including support for LEB128 encoding.

methods.name: ReadOneByte
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadTwoBytes
methods.description: Reads two bytes from the buffer, considering endianness.

methods.name: ReadFourBytes
methods.description: Reads four bytes from the buffer, considering endianness.

methods.name: ReadEightBytes
methods.description: Reads eight bytes from the buffer, considering endianness.

methods.name: ReadUnsignedLEB128
methods.description: Decodes an unsigned LEB128 number from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadSignedLEB128
methods.description: Decodes a signed LEB128 number from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadOffset
methods.description: Reads an offset value using a specified offset reader function.

methods.name: ReadAddress
methods.description: Reads an address value using a specified address reader function.

methods.name: SetCFIDataBase
methods.description: Sets the base address for CFI data sections.

methods.name: SetTextBase
methods.description: Sets the base address for text sections.

methods.name: SetDataBase
methods.description: Sets the base address for data sections.

methods.name: SetFunctionBase
methods.description: Sets the base address for function sections.

methods.name: ClearFunctionBase
methods.description: Clears the function base address setting.
